grand-tour-of-switzerland-davos-andermat.title: Grand Tour of Switzerland: Davos to Andermatt
grand-tour-of-switzerland-davos-andermat.slogan: Davos to Andermatt, over 2383 m · one way

waypoints.name: Davos
waypoints.advice: Davos is where the day begins. Next is Fluela Pass.

waypoints.name: Fluela Pass
waypoints.advice: Fluela Pass comes up 51 km in. Nothing on this route is higher. Next is Bernina Pass.

waypoints.name: Bernina Pass
waypoints.advice: 102 km in you reach Bernina Pass. Next is St Moritz, mostly downhill.

waypoints.name: St Moritz
waypoints.advice: St Moritz, about halfway. Next is Bellinzona.

waypoints.name: Bellinzona
waypoints.advice: Bellinzona sits at 205 km, about halfway. Next is Lugano.

waypoints.name: Lugano
waypoints.advice: Lugano comes up 256 km in. Next is Andermatt.

waypoints.name: Andermatt
waypoints.advice: Andermatt closes the day.

sections.advice: Davos → Fluela Pass climbs about 2383 m in 11 km. This is the part worth slowing down for - look through the bends and use the pull-offs.
Fluela Pass → Bernina Pass is 49 km of rhythm rather than effort. Let it flow and let the view breathe.
Bernina Pass → St Moritz drops about 2330 m over 21 km. Brakes and eyes forward; the views are behind the corners, not in them.
St Moritz → Bellinzona is 88 km of getting across. Ride it tidily and keep the enthusiasm for what comes after.
Bellinzona → Lugano is 27 km of rhythm rather than effort. Let it flow and let the view breathe.
Lugano → Andermatt is 94 km of getting across. Ride it tidily and keep the enthusiasm for what comes after.

scenicChapters.title: Grand Tour of Switzerland
scenicChapters.narrative: The last of the trees go and the road runs out onto open ground. The summit sits at 2383 m, and what surrounds it is rock, weather and distance — cold comes early up here and stays late. Ride it with something in reserve: the summit is not the end of the work, only the middle of it.
scenicChapters.riderNote: Check the pass is open before you commit to it.

scenicChapters.title: Grand Tour of Switzerland
scenicChapters.narrative: For 29 km this is Grand Tour of Switzerland, a road with a name of its own and a reason for it. Expect company on a summer weekend. Early is better than fast.

grand-tour-of-switzerland-davos-andermat.story: A 307 km one-way ride from near Davos, about 4 h 59 of riding. The stops in between: Fluela Pass, Bernina Pass, St Moritz and Bellinzona. The highest point is about 2,500 m. Fluela Pass is subject to seasonal closure - check it is open before you set off. It suits an unhurried touring pace.
